Letter: Lincolnshire, North Lincolnshire and North East Lincolnshire

details.body: The Minister of State for Local Government and English Devolution, has issued a statutory invitation to all councils in two tier areas and small neighbouring unitary authorities to develop unitary proposals - which will bring together lower and upper tier local government services in new unitary councils.
